title: feat(nm2oricyccrdz): neighbor-read of cyclic lex-smallest Orient at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Same negative under the lex-smallest tie-break: neighbour-read holds only at A and fails at B, C, D, so both pairs still fail. With #7461 this shows the collapse of the headline HOLD under a nearest-neighbour requirement is itself tie-break robust.
